decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through direct damage spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Goblin Guide, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and finish the game before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm, Skullcrack, and Roiling Vortex also helps to prevent the opponent from gaining life or gaining incremental advantage. The mana base is optimized for efficiency and consistency to ensure a fast and relentless assault on the opponent.

This deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously loop cards from the graveyard to create a powerful combo. By combining Emry, Lurker of the Loch and other low-cost artifacts like Mishra's Bauble, players can generate infinite mana and draw their entire library. This allows them to win the game with Thassa's Oracle or deal lethal damage with spells like Unholy Heat. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and control the game. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and outpace opponents with its explosive potential.

The main concept of this Aggro-Death's Shadow deck is to utilize cards like Death's Shadow, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to control the game by using efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt, Drown in the Loch, and Unholy Heat. Additionally, the inclusion of Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble allows for card advantage and graveyard synergy. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and flexibility to the deck.

The deck focuses on destroying opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan using a combination of removal spells, land destruction, graveyard hate, and a proactive threat in the form of Karn, the Great Creator. It also utilizes powerful black mana ramp with Cabal Coffers, while also having a late-game win condition with Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to control the game and grind out victories through attrition and resource denial.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt. The main win condition is Omnath, Locus of Creation, which allows for explosive plays and massive amounts of value. The deck also includes powerful enchantments like Leyline Binding to further control the board. Overall, the deck focuses on card advantage, tempo plays, and efficient removal to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to consistently loop through your graveyard and recast powerful spells, especially with the help of Mox Amber and Mishra's Bauble for mana acceleration. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, such as Grinding Station and Thassa's Oracle, to win the game in a fast and efficient manner. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and control the game tempo, making it a versatile and resilient strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with cheap and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, backed up by disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early, while also disrupting their game plan to secure a quick victory. Cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Dauthi Voidwalker provide additional value and card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon can also disrupt opponent's mana base, giving this deck an edge in the early game.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to maintain board control and pressure the opponent. By combining efficient removal spells like Terminate with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize. Blood Moon provides additional disruption against multicolor decks, while Feign Death and Undying Malice provide flexibility and resilience to the deck's threats. Overall, the deck seeks to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory through aggressive plays and disruptive interactions.

The primary focus of this Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to utilize the powerful Death's Shadow creature alongside cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to disrupt the opponent's strategy and apply early pressure. The deck also includes Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration for card advantage, as well as Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat for removal and burn damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion adds an additional layer of versatility to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, disruptive, and efficient in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip the hammer for free and swing for lethal damage. Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga help tutor for key pieces, while cards like Paradise Mantle and Springleaf Drum provide additional ways to equip the hammer quickly. Inkmoth Nexus can also be used as an alternate win condition by turning into a creature and equipping the hammer. Disruption is provided through counterspells like Spell Pierce and disruptive creatures like Esper Sentinel. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and close out the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to consistently recur artifacts from the graveyard, generating value and setting up a combo finish with Thassa's Oracle. It also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to fill up the graveyard and generate card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Unholy Heat helps control the board and protect the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble its pieces, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and win the game through a powerful combo finish.

The deck aims to control the game by utilizing a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. It also includes cards that allow for card advantage and efficient removal options. The inclusion of the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard adds another layer of synergy to the deck. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while generating value and advantage for the pilot.

The deck aims to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate significant amounts of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements like Oblivion Stone, Karn Liberated, and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own win conditions. The deck also includes powerful threats like Sundering Titan, Wurmcoil Engine, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to close out the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional value and consistency to the deck.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures to fill the graveyard quickly and then casting Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Curator of Mysteries and Shardless Agent to help cycle through the deck and set up the Living End combo. Force of Negation and Subtlety provide protection from opponent's disruption, while Grief acts as a disruptive element to the opponent's hand. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Oliphaunt once Living End is cast.

The deck focuses on filling the graveyard with key cards like Narcomoeba, Prized Amalgam, and Creeping Chill using cards like Cathartic Reunion and Tome Scour. By utilizing Dredge cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, the player can quickly fill their graveyard and bring back creatures with powerful effects. The deck aims to combo off by using cards like Conflagrate and Ox of Agonas to finish off the opponent in a quick and explosive manner while utilizing cards like Silversmote Ghoul and Thrilling Discovery to maintain card advantage and fuel the graveyard for future combos.

This deck aims to utilize a toolbox of creatures to create powerful combo interactions. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the player can search for specific creatures to enhance their strategy. The deck focuses on efficient creatures that can provide value on their own, such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The inclusion of cards like Zulaport Cutthroat and Endurance adds flexibility and disruption to the deck, allowing for different lines of play depending on the situation. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through its versatile creature selection.
